title: Delivery Receipt Authorization Form
subtitle: Distribution Delivery Receipt: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Delivery Receipt Authorization Form controls purchase-order shipment, handling unit, seal, receiving dock, and custody transfer by tying each Distribution Delivery Receipt custody, document, or movement decision to the consignee / receiving authority, a stated boundary, and an expiry. The receiving lead preserves conditions, exceptions, confirmation, and both sides of the handoff.
use_case: Use Delivery Receipt Authorization Form at origin, destination dock, staging zone, and receiving location. Check applicable Distribution Delivery Receipt requirements, list the affected quantity, value, document, route, or custody action, and state its limit. Record whether the consignee / receiving authority approves, conditions, holds, or declines the request; obtain renewed consent before changing purchase-order shipment, handling unit, seal, receiving dock, and custody transfer scope.

sections.title: Decision context and authorization record
sections.guidance: For Distribution Delivery Receipt, identify responsible parties, origin, destination dock, staging zone, and receiving location, and the linked purchase-order shipment, handling unit, seal, receiving dock, and custody transfer source.

fields.label: Handling-unit, pallet, carton, lot, and item identifiers

sections.title: Requested scope, limits, and decision lines
sections.guidance: Capture Distribution Delivery Receipt facts for purchase-order shipment, handling unit, seal, receiving dock, and custody transfer; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Authorization conditions and final decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Distribution Delivery Receipt conditions; have receiving lead assign the next Distribution Delivery Receipt owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Distribution Delivery Receipt when identity, count, condition, handling, or custody acceptance remains unresolved. Retain the available Distribution Delivery Receipt proof and route unresolved purchase-order shipment, handling unit, seal, receiving dock, and custody transfer scope to receiving lead.
